en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street scene with a large two‑storey inn or guesthouse on a corner, bearing the sign "Gasthof zur goldenen Taube" and smaller text with the proprietor's name. A few people stand in front of the building. Other traditional houses with steep tiled roofs line the street. Printed in red at the bottom is the greeting "Gruss aus Ostrau i. S." and along the left margin publishing information.
